intake_pct_of_plan.label: Food intake against plan
intake_pct_of_plan.why: Food intake is {delta} {unit} from the nearest limit. Watch applies below 90% for 3 days; Act below 75% for a week.
intake_pct_of_plan.action: Eat the planned menu and fluids, and tell the flight surgeon if intake stays low.
intake_pct_of_plan.howToMeasure: Log what share of the planned menu you ate today, as a percentage.
intake_pct_of_plan.whyItMatters: Inadequate food and nutrition cause decrements in health and performance. Low intake becomes an extra reason in bone, immune and mood alerts.

vitamin_d_ng_ml.label: Vitamin D level
vitamin_d_ng_ml.why: Vitamin D is {delta} {unit} from the 35 ng/mL lower edge of the optimal range.
vitamin_d_ng_ml.action: Discuss the result with the flight surgeon.
vitamin_d_ng_ml.howToMeasure: Enter the result of a blood test if one is taken in flight.
vitamin_d_ng_ml.whyItMatters: The optimal range is 35 to 90 ng/mL. Driftwatch never tells anyone to take supplements, because too much calcium may cause kidney stones.
vitamin_d_ng_ml.source: NASA OCHMO-TB-030 (bone loss technical brief) for the 35 to 90 ng/mL optimal range; the Watch mapping is a design value
